text:
sara-marketing: Quick sync: running a single 60min "Virtual Launch Office Hours" on June 8 but with localized replay packages. Need reg page copy variants (EN/DE/JP), Zoom template, captions/subtitles flow, and post-event lead scoring + SFDC routing. Can we split responsibilities?
miguel-ops: I can own Zoom template + recording config. Proposal: disable waiting room, enable cloud transcript, record gallery+shared screen, enable alternative hosts. Passcode optional?
rachel-growth: Passcode hurts conversion in some regions. Suggest leave OFF for marketing session but enable email-only registration + unique join links. That way replays still gated.
meera-analytics: For lead scoring: compute event_score = (attended?20:0) + (watch_percent*0.4) + (chat_msgs*5) + (clip_download?10:0). Push integer 0-100 to SFDC field `Event_Score__c`. Above 60 -> SDR task.
clip-bot: clip-bot: After recording, will generate speaker-segmented VTT + up to 5 auto-clips using keyword salience (model-based). Clips stored to s3://events/launch2026/replays/{locale}/. Metadata file emitted to /sns/events/clip-ready.
video-team: We need the VTT and rough cut markers. Also request a "lead_spark" 30s highlight clip per locale for AE outreach. ETA 24h if auto-clips exist.
sara-marketing: Reg page needs: localized headline, one-sentence benefit, 2 CTAs (add to calendar / join live). Consent copy must mention clips and follow-up. Draft EN: "Yes, send me event highlights and short clips from Redwood Inference." Keep single checkbox.
legal: Quick note: must include link to privacy policy and opt-out instructions in follow-up emails. Checkbox language OK.
miguel-ops: Zoom settings I will template: cloud recording (record active speaker + gallery), auto-transcript ON, alternative hosts set to producers, auto-start recording when host joins = ON. Post-meeting webhook->opsbot will push raw mp4 + vtt to S3.
opsbot: opsbot: Webhook created: `https://hooks.redwood.internal/zoom/recordings/launch2026`. Raw files will land under `/full/{locale}/`. Retention: 90d raw, 365d processed clips for AE.
meera-analytics: SFDC mapping sample (please use this mapping):
```
Contact.Email -> Lead.Email
form:utm_campaign -> Lead.Campaign__c
form:locale -> Lead.Locale__c
event_score -> Lead.Event_Score__c
preferred_time -> Lead.Preferred_Followup_Window__c
```
Also include `First_Touch_Channel__c` for campaign attribution.
rachel-growth: Follow-up cadence: 0h thank-you + replay ETA; 24h localized highlight reel (3 clips); 48h AE nudge for high-score leads; 7d nurture drip. Templates will be localized.
video-team: For naming convention, propose: `{event}/{locale}/YYYYMMDD/clip_{n}_{start}_{end}_{tag}.mp4` and metadata JSON: `title, speakers, start_ms, end_ms, keywords, score`.
clip-bot: clip-bot: Confirmed naming. Will emit SNS with `clip_uri` and `metadata_uri`.
sara-marketing: AEs want autodelivery if event_score >=80. But we should first let video-team trim 1-sentence intro. Plan: clip-bot -> video-team queue (auto trims) -> AE inbox + SFDC Lead attachment. Good?
video-team: Good. We can do fast-trim pipeline for owned clips; please add `clip_priority` flag in metadata.
meera-analytics: Also capture a boolean `watched_full` if watch_percent >90. Useful signal.
sara-marketing: OK final checklist: miguel to provision Zoom template + webhook by 6/1; rachel to deliver localized reg pages by 6/2; meera to wire SFDC fields and test mapping by 6/3; video-team to confirm trimming SLA. Ill draft EN/reg copy now and drop in this thread.
miguel-ops: On it. I'll post the Zoom template ID and test meeting link when ready.
sf-bot: sf-bot: Test lead created (sf-test+launch@redwood.com) and Event_Score__c updated on 2026-05-04 16:12 UTC.
sara-marketing: thanks all! small ask: include captioning burn-in option for JP locale. rachel can you add a note in reg form about subtitles?
rachel-growth: Will do — add a checkbox "I need subtitles" so we can prioritize JP/DE captions.
sara-marketing: perfect :sparkles:
